I finally decided to do it. I asked for three months off, and my boss agreed to keep my job open.
On a whim? You have been talking about that trip for two years.
Not on a whim, no. I kept planning it and then finding a reason to wait. Last week I stopped waiting.
And what made you stop hesitating?
My sister. She refused to listen to my excuses and offered to look after the flat. After that I had no argument left.
I would love to do something like that, but I have too many commitments here. I keep saying next year.
You always say that. Have you considered asking for one month instead of three? Nobody expects you to disappear.
I have not, actually. I might try talking to my director. She is stubborn, but she is fair.
I'm considering asking for a month off.
I suggest offering one more revision.
I would avoid agreeing to that in writing.
She refused to listen to my excuses.
I kept planning it, and eventually I just booked it.

So I did the thing. I stopped saying next year and I actually booked it. You know I have been promising to take that ceramics course since we met, and every January I decide to start and then I avoid looking at the website until March. This time I did not hesitate. I paid for the whole term on a Tuesday afternoon, on a whim, and now I cannot get the money back, which is exactly why I did it that way. The first class is on the ninth. I am reluctant to tell my mother, because she will want to come with me, and she is even more stubborn than I am. Anyway, that is my news. Eventually I will learn to do things without a deadline forcing me.

Ana, before you reply to that email, two things. The client has asked to add two more cities, which means the scope has changed, and they seem to expect us to absorb it. I would avoid agreeing to anything in writing today. Second, they want a third revision of the film, and we had agreed to two. I suggest offering one more revision and asking them to pay for the extra cities. Renata refused to sign anything last week until the numbers were clear, and she was right. So please do not promise to deliver in March. Just say we need to review the scope, and that you will come back to them on Thursday.
